ad_creative_body: ["Chapter 1 Prologue\\n\\"Malia, wait here,\\" my father ordered as he raced outside.\\nI sighed, this happens almost all of the time. We're attacked, my parents fight them, and then we go back to our normal lives. As a thirteen year old, it was starting to annoy me that my parents wouldn't let me join in. However, I listened to my father and patiently waited for them to return. After all, if I disobeyed them, I would be punished.\\nI glanced at the bloody whip and shuddered, horrific memories swam in my mind, reminding me to always listen to my Alphas.\\nThat's right, I can't call them mom or dad, I have to call them Alpha or Luna. It makes me sick, while everyone else can have normal parents, I end up being the demons' daughter. Though, I guess being the Rogue Alphas meant they had to be cruel. But to their own daughter?\\nI frowned, maybe it's supposed to be like this. Maybe being cruel is showing love. Maybe everyone else is just...weird.\\n\\"Malia?\\" My mother's voice sounded.\\nI got up from the chair and walked into the foyer, \\"Yes, Luna?\\" I asked.\\nHer brown eyes landed on me, she sighed in relief, \\"You're safe. Good.\\"\\nShe walked past me, not giving me another glance. That is the extent of her motherly love, being relieved that I'm not dead. Yet.\\n\\"Clean up the family room, those mutts messed it up,\\" my father grumbled as he walked in.\\nI nodded, \\"Yes, Alpha.\\"\\nAnd that is how my father is, never shows an ounce of love. But I guess that's just how it is, maybe love shouldn't exist. Maybe it doesn't.\\nI turned to clean the family room when a gunshot sounded. I winced from the sudden sound before rushing into the kitchen. My eyes widened at the sight before me.\\nLying on the ground, in a pool of her own blood, was my mother. Kneeling beside her, crying silently, was my father. In my thirteen years of life, my father has never shown any emotion besides anger. Seeing him cry, even if it was silent, scared me more than any punishment could.\\nAnother bullet crashed through the window before landing in the wall. This seemed to snap my father out of his daze, he looked at me, his eyes widening.\\n\\"Run!\\" He ordered.\\nI swallowed, \\"But what about you? What about mom?\\"\\nHe clenched his fists before pulling me into a hug, \\"I know we haven't been the best, but we have always loved you. But showing love makes you weak, never forget that.\\"\\nI nodded, kissed him on the cheek, and ran out the door. I cried as I continued running, trying to escape the men chasing me. I stumbled upon a river and stopped at the edge.\\n\\"Looks like the pup is cornered,\\" a man sneered.\\nI spun around, my heart was pounding against my chest. I had no idea what to do, I never experienced a situation like this. They have their guns pointed at me, holding the power to kill me any second.\\nBefore they could shoot, a large wolf attacked them. At first, I believed it was my father, but it wasn't. He tore them all apart, soaking his muzzle in their blood. Once they were all dead, he looked at me.\\n\\"Who are you?\\" I asked.\\nThe wolf shifted back to reveal a handsome young man. His hair was dark, almost black, and his eyes were a beautiful blue.\\n\\"That's not important, what is important is that you leave my father's territory. He'll kill you if he finds you,\\" he ordered, covering himself up.\\nI furrowed my eyebrows, \\"You're Alpha Darius' son, aren't you?\\"\\nHe smirked, \\"I am. Now, go!\\"\\n\\"Wait, why are you helping me?\\"\\nHe watched me for a moment, he then looked away, \\"I don't want to see a beautiful gem, like you, get killed. Now, go, please.\\"\\nAnd so, for the second time that day, I ran away. I continued running until I collapsed onto someone else's territory.\\nSomeone who despises rogues, but for whatever reason, felt mercy for me.\\n\\nChapter 2\\n\\"Malia?\\"\\nI looked up from my sketchbook to see my older sister, Ella, poking her head into my room.\\n\\"Yeah?\\" I asked, setting my book down.\\nShe let out a sob as she sprinted over to me, I furrowed my eyebrows in confusion.\\n\\"El, what's wrong?\\" I asked, trying to calm her down.\\n\\"You know how dad is stepping down from being Alpha?\\" She asked.\\nI nodded silently.\\n\\"Well, I haven't found my mate yet and they agreed to....have me marry Alpha Odysseus until I find my mate.\\"\\nI furrowed my eyebrows, \\"You mean...the Alpha who killed our little brother?\\"\\nShe nodded, \\"I can't be with someone like him. What if I never find my mate and end up needing to mate with Odysseus? You know how he is, controlling, rude, arrogant-\\n\\"You'll find your mate someday, El. Besides, you just have to marry him, I didn't hear you have to mate with him.\\"\\n\\"Well, no, mom and dad are making sure he knows he is not to touch me. Thank god for that, I want to save myself for my mate.\\"\\nI frowned, \\"If marrying him means the pack will stay safe....\\"\\nI trailed off, we both knew that this was our only option. Ever since our father had lost his wolf due to silver, our Beta has been taking care of the pack. But he is stepping down as well, that's the rule. If our Alpha steps down and gives the title to his heir, female or male, then the Beta's child will become the new Beta. Which left us with my incredibly shy sister and our extremely rude cousin. He would definitely take advantage and make the laws, Odysseus becoming our Alpha will save us from splitting.\\nThere are many other Alphas who are unmated, but none of them are like Odysseus. They aren't strong, feared, respected, or strict. I have seen their packs, the males are a bunch of animals while the females are forced to stay inside the house. Clearly, they don't understand that it's 2016.\\nElle wiped her tears, \\"But he's a cold-hearted man, Lia, he doesn't have any ounce of love in him. He'll treat me like trash.\\"\\nI raised an eyebrow, \\"And how do you know that?\\"\\n\\"Remember, Liz was engaged to him?\\"\\n\\"Yes, she found her mate and left him.\\"\\n\\"Wait...what?\\"\\nI rolled my eyes, \\"You were listening to her mother's lies again, weren't you?\\"\\n\\"Maybe.\\"\\n\\"Ella...\\"\\n\\"Fine, but how are you on his side? He killed a five year old child. Just because that child stepped onto his territory. Oh, let's not forget that child was our little brother.\\"\\nI stiffened, \\"I'm only thinking for the pack, that's what I have always been raised to do. But trust me, I don't like the guy either.\\"\\nI couldn't. He murdered our five year old brother, he tortured him for days. He made sure our father knew that too, he had sent us videos. I shivered at the memory that was ten years after Ella's parents took me in. Now, I'm twenty-one and have to watch my sister marry the guy.\\n\\"Mom and dad are disgusted with themselves,\\" Ella mumbled. \\"But come to think of it, it was either him or... the Alpha Jared.\\"\\nI made a disgusted look, \\"We better thank mom and dad for convincing Odysseus to agree to this. But come to think of it, why is he agreeing to this? I mean, Liz told me he's a very...difficult guy. He doesn't like sharing his position with anyone. And you becoming his Luna is sharing that power.\\"\\n\\"Well, marrying me means his pack will become larger.\\"\\n\\"Yes, but once you find your mate...\\"\\nShe sighed, \\"I don't know, but I hate this. I hate how sick dad is right now, I hate how I'm being forced to marry the guy who brought heartache to our family and pack, and I hate how bad Alpha Jared is. God, if he didn't abuse women then I would totally marry him instead!\\"\\n\\"Mom got lucky with dad, most Alphas are like cavemen. They treat women like they're only good for having pups.\\"\\n\\"Well, most Alphas give into their animalistic ways.\\"\\nI nodded, \\"True.\\"\\n\\"Including Odysseus.\\"\\nI groaned, \\"Ella, I can't do anything about this-\\n\\"You marry him!\\"\\nI gaped at her, \\"Crazy girl say what?\\"\\nChapter 3\\nShe rolled her eyes before grinning, \\"I don't want to be an Alpha at all, you know this, but our parents don't. Maybe if-\\n\\"No, I am not marrying Odysseus. I was a rogue, El. I still have the golden eyes of a rogue when I get upset, he hates rogues! They killed his whole family!\\"\\n\\"Please, Lia? Please!\\"\\n\\"No!\\"\\nShe frowned, \\"You know Odysseus hates the idea of a weak Luna..and that's what I am.\\"\\nI clenched my jaw, she does have a point. Ella has never been a great fighter, matter of fact, she hates it. She is, however, something much more than some warrior. She's a healer, destined to be a pack doctor, but she refuses to tell our parents. She has always been afraid of disappointing them, but I don't believe they'll be disappointed. Odysseus, on the other hand, will hate her. He'll force her to train, to go on patrols, to be what a Luna should be. That and Odysseus hates healers too. She's pretty much screwed.\\nI ran a hand through my hair, my sister wouldn't survive being his wife. I looked back at her to see her shaking, my heart broke for her. She doesn't deserve this, she isn't strong enough. Physically and mentally.\\nI let out a heavy sigh, \\"Fine....I'll marry him.\\"\\nI'm going to die.\\n\\nI pinched the bridge of my nose as Ella panicked at the door. We have been standing here for fifteen minutes while our parents and Beta discussed plans in our father's office.\\n\\"What if they hate me?\\" She asked quietly.\\nI sighed, \\"El, they won't hate you. Being a healer is a gift from the Moon Goddess.\\"\\n\\"You're right. Okay okay, I got this.\\"\\n\\"Five years later....\\" I mumbled.\\nShe flashed me a glare, \\"Fine. You open it.\\"\\nI smirked, \\"say no more.\\" \\nI shoved the door open, scaring our parents and the Beta. I watched as the beta, Ivan, fell out of his chair, whacking his head on the ground. My mother shook her head in amusement while my father burst out laughing.\\n\\"Ha. Ha. Very funny, what do you two girls want?\\" Ivan grumbled.\\nI bit my lip, \\"Well, Ella and I have been talking...\\"\\n\\"And?\\" Our mother urged.\\nElla released a breath, \\"I....I don't want to be an Alpha. I have a gift to heal others and....I want to become a pack doctor or healer. Whichever you prefer to call me.\\"\\nOur parents stared at her in shock, causing her to become nervous again.\\n\\"And I would marry Alpha Odysseus,\\" I stated.\\nThey then looked at me, their mouths now hanging open. Ivan furrowed his eyebrows before gaping at us.\\n\\"You two are nuts!\\" He exclaimed.\\n\\"Honey, if he finds out you're a rogue...\\" our mother trailed off as tears formed in her eyes. \\"Ella is an Alpha, he won't hurt her.\\"\\n\\"But she isn't a warrior, he'll force her to become one. What if she freezes in battle? Odysseus is known for not having any mercy. The only reason he was engaged to Liz is because she opened her legs for him. There is no one else. Besides, you know my biological father was a rogue Alpha. I have alpha blood in me.\\"\\nIvan frowned, \\"Yes, but he wasn't born out of an Alpha.\\"\\n\\"Actually, he was. He was Alpha Roman's eldest son, but he went rogue because his father didn't want him to become Alpha. It was a whole Lion King type. So, Malia is of Alpha blood as well....but she's also of rogue blood,\\" our father explained.\\n\\"Which causes this whole problem of hiding that from Odysseus. He's not someone you want to mess with. Calm yet deadly, that's exactly what he is,\\" our mother sighed.\\nOur father studied Ella and I for a bit before releasing a breath, \\"Are you sure about this, Malia?\\"\\nOur mother looked at him with bewilderment, \\"Zander, you aren't actually considering this, are you? I will not throw her to his feet! Adopted daughter or not, she is still my baby and is part rogue! He'll-\\n\\"Malia is quite skilled at hiding her rogue blood, Victoria. I'm sure she can hide it from him until she finds her mate. I trust her. She's an incredibly strong warrior, that'll blind Odysseus.\\"\\nIvan slowly nodded, \\"I agree, Odysseus isn't really...into Ella. He knows she isn't a warrior, but Malia...\\"\\nOur mother frowned, \\"Fine...but as soon as something goes wrong, you run. Got it?\\" She demanded, giving me a stern look.\\nI quickly nodded, \\"I will, I promise.\\"\\n\\"Well, then it's decided....Malia will be Odysseus' bride,\\" our father whispered.\\n\\nChapter 4\\n\\n\\"So, when will I meet him?\\"  I asked.\\nMy father finished chewing his food before clearing his throat, \\"He's visiting tomorrow afternoon. I must warn you, that man has been through a lot, he doesn't understand love at all. Whenever someone does show him love, he immediately shuts them out. For whatever reason, he's terrified of loving someone.\\"\\n\\"Okay...\\"\\n\\"What he's trying to say is, we know you can be a romantic at times, but don't expect Odysseus to fall in love with you. He only fell in love once and that was a long time ago.\\"\\n\\"Really? Who was she?\\" Ella asked.\\nOur father shrugged, \\"He never said, he just said she was breathtaking.\\"\\n\\"Like I would ever love him,\\" I scoffed. \\"He tortured our five year old brother and then killed him. He's a sick monster.\\"\\n\\"That, he is,\\" our mother agreed.\\n\\"Well, if he does anything, I'll kill him,\\" Ivan grumbled. \\"He killed my sister.\\"\\nElla frowned, \\"How many people did he kill?\\"\\n\\"Half of our pack, wiped out two other packs, and killed thousands of rogues,\\" our father sighed. \\"He's an impressive Alpha, but he doesn't know control. He only knows to kill and to claim what is his.\\"\\n\\"I feel bad for his mate,\\" Ivan voiced. \\"I'm going to laugh if she's feisty.\\"\\nI smirked, \\"Well, I will be his wife for a while...\\"\\n\\"Lord help him, you're going to make him jump out a window,\\" Ella laughed.\\nIvan grinned, \\"If he gets a mate like you, the boy will run away before a month is up.\\"\\nMy father shook his head, \\"You are all nuts.\\" \\n\\nOnce dinner was done, I decided to retreat to my room, exhausted from today's events. If Ella was a fighter and not submissive, I would have never agreed to this. But I knew that if she was sent on patrols and rogues attacked, she would freeze up. I've handled men worse than Odysseus, he can't be as terrible as everyone says. I, for one, refuse to be afraid of him. As soon as I show fear towards him, he wins.\\nI sighed as I stepped out onto my balcony, drawn by the loud noise. Across the forest was a large clearing that held a massive house. That massive house is Odysseus' packhouse, if I ever bothered, I would have been able to see him. But I never cared for him, he never bothered me. Even now, as they all cheered around a bonfire, I didn't bother to grab some binoculars to see if I could spot their Alpha.\\nThe perks of having a packhouse on a large hill. \\n\\"Stalking your future husband?\\" Ella asked, walking into my room.\\nI didn't bother to look at her as I shook my head, \\"No, I don't care for him.\\"\\n\\"But-\\n\\"I only came out here to see what the noise was, they're having a party.\\"\\nShe stood beside me and smirked, when she pulled out her binoculars, I rolled my eyes.\\n\\"El...\\"\\n\\"I heard he's hot, why not check?\\" She mused.\\nI rolled my eyes again as she peered through the binoculars, at the sound of her gasp, I snapped my attention back to her.\\n\\"What?\\" I asked.\\nShe slowly looked away, \\"Look! Look at the lonely looking guy, that's Alpha Odysseus.\\"\\nI shook my head, \\"No. I am not going to be some creep.\\"\\n\\"He looks so lonely...\\"\\n\\"El, don't even get any ideas. Someone like him can't be fixed.\\"\\n\\"But maybe he just needs someone to give him a chance,\\" she argued.\\nI frowned, \\"El, he probably has mental issues from his past. You can't just...fix someone like him.\\"\\n\\"Why not?\\"\\nI glanced back at my balcony, \\"Because he was raised to be like this. His father-\\n\\"Alpha Darius didn't raise his son to be lonely.\\"\\nI paled, \\"What?\\"\\n\\"Alpha Darius didn't-\\n\\"His father is...oh my god.\\"\\nShe frowned, \\"What?\\"\\n\\"That boy who told me to run, who attacked his own pack members to protect me, that was Odysseus.\\""]
